items.action: Refresh from @earendil-works/pi-ai@1.5.0 with tools/CompatibilityReport/refresh-model-catalogs.mjs. 1.5.0 generates the catalog from models.dev v2 by the rules under packages/ai/catalog/ (generate-models.ts is gone), and drops realtime and image-only models from the chat catalog.
items.result: Refreshed from @earendil-works/pi-ai@1.5.0 with tools/CompatibilityReport/refresh-model-catalogs.mjs in the ai area (3e657609): the 42 provider shards are byte copies of the 1.5.0 package (1712 models; realtime and image-only chat models dropped as upstream), BuiltinModelCatalog's shard hashes, the Durable shard hashes and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md (package SHA256 e320fe7b...) follow, and Models.Tests checks them.

items.pin: The Pi version PiSharp identifies as: pi/1.2.0 user agents, MCP clientInfo.version, the bug-report and crash-log Pi version, the interactive context version default.
items.action: Move to 1.5.0 with the ai area. 1.4.0 makes the default user agent pi/<version> (<platform>; <runtime>; <arch>) everywhere, through pi-ai's ClientIdentity (utils/identity.ts, coding-agent core/client-identity.ts), and sends it on Bedrock, OpenRouter image, pi-messages and classifier requests too.
items.result: pi/1.5.0 user agents come from ClientIdentities.PiVersion ("1.5.0") with the ai area's client identity. In the close-out (96d76e82) the four remaining config.ts VERSION sites read it too: InteractiveModeContext.Version, McpSessionHost.ClientVersion (MCP clientInfo.version), BugReport.PiVersion and CrashLog.RecordCrash's version default; SessionParity's and InteractiveParity's diagnostics cases expect 1.5.0. PiNodeRuntime.PiVersion (node-bridge-pi-runtime) and DurableWire.DurableVersion (durable-upstream-pins) are not identity and stay 1.2.0.

items.pin: PiNodeRuntime.PiVersion = "1.2.0" (the npm package set TypeScript extensions run against); the port-upstream.mjs COMMIT, its upstream-exports.json snapshot and the selftest commit.
items.action: Move to the Pi 1.5.0 npm packages, add @earendil-works/pi-schema to the package set, and regenerate the compatibility modules with port-upstream.mjs from v1.5.0. pi-ai no longer re-exports TypeBox: 1.5.0 maps an extension's TypeBox import from pi-ai to pi-ai's compat entry (core/extensions/pi-ai-extension-view.ts).
items.result: The compatibility modules were re-ported at v1.5.0 (c4e38fa3): port-upstream.mjs COMMIT, upstream-exports.json and the selftest name f9a26365, and pi-schema is ported. The npm package set extensions run against stays on Pi 1.2.0 (PiNodeRuntime.PiVersion = "1.2.0") by the owner's 2026-11-05 decision (bridge.undici-gondolin-advisories, decision 0013 safe defaults), because pi-agent-core 1.5.0 attributes requests to Pi by default; an npm override pins undici to 8.12.3 (1054c492).

items.pin: The v1.5.0 event catalog and command/RPC inventory are generated from the v1.2.0 ones against target.lock.json and checked in inventory-refresh.test.mjs (PI_UPSTREAM_V1_5_0 reproduces them).
items.action: Each area adds overlay entries for the native statuses it reassesses (no overlay yet; statuses carry over from v1.2.0).
items.result: Generated in phase 1 (2d90cbbb) from the v1.2.0 inventories and checked by inventory-refresh.test.mjs. No area added an overlay, so native statuses carry over from v1.2.0.

items.pin: Inventories pinning upstream file hashes at 06a4669.
items.action: Regenerate each when its area re-verifies the files it pins.
items.result: The TUI keybindings inventory moved to f9a26365 in the close-out (1029e1c1): keybindings.ts only appends getSelectPageIndex at v1.5.0 (ported), the 47 definitions re-derived from v1.5.0 equal the inventory's, and tools/native-companion-targets.json pins the new file. The Mistral and Azure inventories stay at 06a46693 on purpose: files they pin changed upstream and pi-user-agent.ts was removed, and the ai rows that changed them are ported with deferrals (ai.tool-call-args-incremental: Mistral still writes a full message snapshot per frame; ai.transcript-tool-support: Azure additional_tools and tool search are not implemented). Regenerate each when its deferral is closed.

items.pin: Upstream / SourceSha / sourceSha constants that label each sync suite's report with 06a4669.
items.action: Move each when its suite's area is ported and the suite passes against v1.5.0.
items.result: The 15 sync-suite labels moved to f9a26365 in the close-out (8205eed2), every area they cover being ported and each suite passing; the headers say they are authored from reading and synced under decision 0013. Codemode's declaration and deterministic goldens stay captures of the upstream 1.2.0 packages (their checks unchanged; the report's goldens field says so), as Durable's compat captures stay v1.2.0's. Labels outside this list stay: the v0.99.1 (d86654ab) labels of the suites from the 0f7ec69f snapshot (Agent, Tui, Tools, Sessions, CodingAgent, AnthropicSimple, AzureResponses and the other fixture and oracle suites) record v0.99.1 evidence that decisions 0002, 0006 and 0013 keep unchanged, and neither earlier sync moved them; DurableCli's v1.1.0 label is the Pi v1.1.0 agent pisharp durable ports (decision 0005) and its interop case's checkout pin.

items.pin: DurableUpstream.Commit (06a4669), the pi-durable version a device reports (Wire.DurableVersion 1.2.0), and the port map pin with the commits durable.yml fetches.
items.action: Re-pin with the durable phase (decision 0013 phase 4): build-port-map.mjs against v1.5.0, a durable-sync-1.5.0 work list, then the version constants once the port matches pi-durable 1.5.0.
items.result: Phase 4 moved DurableUpstream.Commit, compatibility/durable-port-map.json (upstreamCommit f9a26365, previousCommit 06a46693), the commits .github/workflows/durable.yml fetches and build-port-map.mjs to v1.5.0 (dac65878); closeout moved the Durable suite's report label, its compat captures staying v1.2.0's. DurableWire.DurableVersion stays "1.2.0": it names the device protocol's durable-pi shapes, and the wire stays v1 (decision 0008).
